q1_issues.issue: The "no one" subject is not represented at all — no Agent, no range over person, and no QuantifierPhrase "no" companion — so the denial is indistinguishable from a plain "Fadil was not found".
Ongoing is emitted for an absolute-clause participle, which is none of the four markers the instruction set says are the only things that license Ongoing.

q2_gaps: negative-quantifier pronoun subject ("no one" / "nobody") — the no/none machinery is written for copular "no N" and for the verbal "none of the Ns V" distribution rule, neither of which fits a bare negative pronoun
"with" + NP + participle absolute clause as a concessive adjunct, including whether its participle licenses Ongoing
scalar "even" over such an adjunct — it has its own focus operator (Even <filler> <event>), while the multi-word connective rule would fold it into the connective head, and nothing says which applies
totality modifier "the whole town" — treated as an ordinary descriptive adjective, so (Member sk_town_1 whole) asserts the town is whole rather than that all of it took part
notes: EvenWith is left off the unlicensed list because the multi-word concessive-connective rule ("even though" to EvenThough, "despite") arguably reaches it, and the main clause is correctly first. Naming (Name fadil "Fadil") with a separate (Member fadil little) is the right split for a lowercase modifier before a personal name, and the collective singular "the town" correctly gets no distribution rule.
